paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Base LLaMA-3.1-8B & Mistral-7B-v0.3 in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of win rates across four large language models, GPT-4o, GPT-40, Mistral, and LLaMA. There are four distinct slices representing these models, with the largest slice, colored in a dark blue, representing GPT-4o at approximately 96.8%, followed by GPT-40 at 98.4%, Mistral at 9.8%, and LLaMA at 3.2%.  The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, indicating the win rate for each model. A legend is not explicitly present, but the colors are consistently associated with each model and the central “Win rate (%)” label provides context.  The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest in size, visually presenting the relative win rates of the different models.
